method.exact_title_rule: Normalized exact matches to current SSOC 2024 titles resolve to the official occupation; no competing composite is published.
method.reviewed_alias_rule: An explicit reviewed title, synonym or definition match may resolve a query to one current SSOC 2024 occupation. Synonyms are not auto-resolved globally.
method.composite_rule: Only task definitions that genuinely span occupations receive an editorial composite with unique, scored SSOC 2024 components and weights summing to one.
method.withheld_rule: Cross-sector or unstable labels are withheld when a fixed mapping would create false precision.
method.point_estimate: Editorial component-weighted mean of ILO 2025 mean_score_2025 values.
method.assumption_sensitivity: Official mapping range plus equal-weight and leave-one-component-out sensitivity checks.
method.comparison: Midrank-compatible empirical location against scored official occupations, with midpoint interpolation between observed values; not an official rank.
forbidden_interpretations: official SSOC occupation for a composite or withheld query
